info.title: RightNow System Zero API
info.description: Decisions over a state, with each selected outcome's estimated probability, every alternative and evidence-backed calibration status. Every answer and refusal carries X-Request-Id.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Sends the request at most once: the same key and body replays the stored answer for 24 hours.

parameters.name: X-Client-Request-Id
parameters.description: Your own id for the request, echoed back.

200.description: Fresh successful answers use structured confidence v1. A stored reply from before the change may use the deprecated legacy branch for its 24 hours of retention, only with X-RightNow-Idempotent-Replay: true. Replay preserves the original body and calibration flags byte for byte. A reply never mixes legacy and v1 successful answers; refusals are unchanged.

boolean.summary: A high-confidence false decision, with calibration unattested.

choice.summary: A choice and all remaining outcomes, with calibration unattested.

score.summary: A selected level distinct from the expected score, with calibration unattested.

4XX.description: A refusal of the request, the key or its limits: error.code names it.

5XX.description: The platform could not answer: retry when error.retryable is true.

get.summary: The names an account can send in the model field.

200.description: The alias, then each version served.

4XX.description: A refusal of the key or its limits.

apiKey.description: A System Zero API key, rnsk_..., as Authorization: Bearer <key>.

X-Request-Id.description: The gateway's id for this request; quote it to support.

X-RateLimit-Remaining.description: Requests left in the key's minute.

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: The unix second the key's window reopens.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before sending again.

Retry-After-Ms.description: The same wait in milliseconds; read it first.

x-should-retry.description: Whether the same request can be answered later: true or false, as error.retryable.

X-RightNow-Idempotent-Replay.description: true on a stored answer replayed for the same Idempotency-Key.

X-Latency-Ms.description: The gateway's time for this answer, in milliseconds.

Server-Timing.description: The gateway's stages and their durations, on answers to a proven key.

criteria.description: Each option's key, and its description or null.

StructuredJson.description: Text, or a JSON object or array; every number finite (an integer past 2^53 - 1 reaches the node digit for digit).

answers.description: One entry per question asked, by its name.

DecideReply.description: Structured confidence v1. Every successful answer requires decision, confidence, alternatives and calibrated; partial metadata and mixed legacy successes are invalid.

probability.description: P(true), even when decision is false. Probabilities use integer millionths; confidence and alternatives preserve the same distribution.

confidence.description: The model's estimated probability that the selected decision is correct, equal to that outcome's released probability. Not a margin; measured reliability depends on the calibration chart's evaluated scope.

calibration_version.description: The node's exact calibration version, preserved unchanged. A nonempty version does not prove calibration.

decision.description: The selected boolean outcome: true when P(true) is at least 0.5, otherwise false. A tie selects true.
Another allowed outcome, with the same decision type as this answer.

confidence.description: This outcome's released probability, not the probability that it is the runner-up.

alternatives.description: Every other allowed outcome exactly once, including zero-probability outcomes. Sorted by descending integer-millionth probability; choice ties use ascending UTF-8 key bytes and score ties use ascending numeric index. No probability mass is omitted.

calibrated.description: True only for an exact evidence-backed gateway release attestation matching the concrete model, calibration version, answer type, context route, serving identity, input attachment-type set and outcome count. Preview, fallback, identity and unattested calibration are false; true does not guarantee future accuracy.

probabilities.description: The complete released distribution in integer millionths, totaling exactly 1000000 units. Confidence equals probabilities[decision]; JSON floating-point sums may use absolute tolerance 0.000001.

confidence.description: The model's estimated probability that the selected decision is correct, equal to that outcome's released probability. Not a margin; measured reliability depends on the calibration chart's evaluated scope.

calibration_version.description: The node's exact calibration version, preserved unchanged. A nonempty version does not prove calibration.

decision.description: The validated node choice, including its selection among tied maxima; exactly equal to choice.

score.description: Expected level index, rounded to six decimals; it can be fractional. Decision confidence describes exact-level correctness, not distance from this expected score.

answers.description: All successful answers use the legacy replay shape; no v1 successes may be mixed in.

LegacyReplayReply.description: Stored pre-v1 reply, returned unchanged only on an idempotent replay within its 24-hour retention. Its confidence is a legacy margin and must not be used as decision probability.

confidence.description: Legacy margin, not the probability of a selected decision. Do not use this value for automation thresholds.

alias_for.description: The version the alias system-zero resolves to; null for a version.

calibration_versions.description: Approved release versions for discovery; null when none are attested. A listed version is not a per-answer calibrated flag: answer type, route, serving identity and input coverage must also match.

state_tokens.description: The longest state one request answers, counted in state tokens. A longer state is refused with 404 long_context_not_available while long_context is held.

rendered_tokens.description: The longest rendered context one request answers, counted in rendered tokens: the state with each question rendered beside it. A longer one is refused with 404 long_context_not_available while long_context is held. Body bytes and the HTTP answer bound still apply independently.

questions.description: The most questions one request may ask.

param.description: The request field the refusal names, in fixed labels: a name a caller chose reads *.

retryable.description: Whether the same request, sent again unchanged, can be answered, after Retry-After when the answer names one.

details.description: The refusal's machine-readable extras: its cause on a 429, a reset, a limit. A stateless text request refused with 404 long_context_not_available names the served bound in max_state_tokens and max_rendered_tokens.
